title: 2025 general budget: all sections
part_text: Text as a whole without the words: ‘and to make use of the funding available under Creative Europe to protect the Jewish heritage in Europe;’
part_context: Underscores the continued socio-economic challenges in the cultural and creative sectors, which are often made up of small organisations and individual artists, and the key role of these sectors in fostering media literacy, combatting disinformation, and promoting and protecting media freedom and pluralism as the basis for a functioning democracy; proposes to increase financing for programmes dedicated to the conservation, restoration, and enhancement of cultural and historical sites, as well as for the promotion of regional traditions and languages <del>and to make use of the funding available under Creative Europe to protect the Jewish heritage in Europe;</del> increases, therefore, the financing for the various strands of the Creative Europe programme by a total of EUR 8 million above the DB;
